node.title: Re: Detection of faulty equipment based on anomaly in sound
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Is there any device that can detect whether a machine is working properly or not based on the sound it produces?

In general, [google://detect faulty equipment based on sound|it appears to be possible].

Or is it possible to develop one and how?

One would probably need some knowledge in [wp://digital signal processing] ([https://ocw.mit.edu/resources/res-6-008-digital-signal-processing-spring-2011/|for example]), and knowledge about the machine one is looking at (which you haven't named). In Perl [mod://PDL] might be useful, there is for example [http://pdl.perl.org/?docs=FFT&title=PDL::FFT|PDL::FFT].
